title: Find words in a grid
statementMd:
Return the sorted list of words from `words` that can be traced in the letter grid through adjacent (up/down/left/right) cells without reusing a cell within a word.

**Example:** `find_words_grid([["o", "a", "a", "n"], ["e", "t", "a", "e"], ["i", "h", "k"…, ["oath", "pea", "eat", "rain"])` returns `["eat", "oath"]`.
hints: DFS for each word, or a trie.
